description: Hand-written edge cases: non-ASCII content, escapes, URL bodies that look like CSS syntax, comments, importance annotations, empty values, and unclosed constructs. Also the values whose only harvest source was a test file deleted when the ported value pipeline replaced its predecessor: they have no source to be re-harvested from, so they are held here by hand.
